title: TSMC plans celebration for Arizona milestone as it weighs US$22.6 billion Texas campus
html:
TSMC is preparing to celebrate a new milestone in Arizona, even as it weighs a $22.6 billion fab in Texas and faces fresh tariff threats from Washington.
